title: Edit Checkout Pages: How To Edit Checkout URL
text:
## Edit Checkout Pages: How To Edit Checkout URL
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000084213

## Overview
A default checkout page URL looks like this:
www.domain.com/checkout/2
The value " 2 " at the end of the URL comes from the membership plan ID number:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166155004/original/MBIXihcZTBJ_DK3KHfgIr1y4t8XNMwyBlg.png?1755698977 | alt: ]

## How To Edit Checkout URLs
The " checkout " portion of the URL can be changed by navigating to Settings » Advanced Settings and conducting a keyword search for " Default Checkout URL ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166155159/original/vORnApHwsBackS8PRBBIl2zON00vAFo7yQ.png?1755699054 | alt: ]
For this example, the URL segment was changed from checkout to checkout-pay :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12101662595/original/Y9rAfyjiDkJP42_Y9F6D2OFUzETXDPw4Fg.png?1638285276 | alt: ]
It is also possible to change the portion of the URL that follows this segment., which is "2" in this example. To accomplish this, navigate to Finance » Membership Plans and click Edit on the preferred membership plan:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166155348/original/crpV7NI49F270VgY89sQiO8Z3IDzEv8now.png?1755699160 | alt: ]
Then search for the setting " Member Signup Page URL ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166155412/original/taOTtkdn6wAkJEPPm8sNe7rjXy1vkrY8FQ.png?1755699208 | alt: ]
“In this example, the value was changed from ‘2’ to ‘ featured ’:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12101663182/original/M2etK2fD-wdlJoDikc-IHDsECSiDu6Em6A.png?1638285723 | alt: ]

## Important Rules About The "Member Signup Page URL" Setting:
If the setting is left blank, the system will assign the membership plan's ID# as the value.
Letters, numbers, underscores, and dashes are allowed. EG: gold-plan
Each membership plan's checkout URL has to be unique.
A membership plan ID cannot be used as the URL value for another checkout page.
